dict.string: Dreamsign wakes you with real alarms that ring through Silent mode and Focus, and keeps them coming until you're truly up.
Dreamsign counts your steps for the Walk wake-up challenge. Nothing leaves your iPhone.
Dreamsign scans the barcode or QR code you chose for the Scan wake-up challenge. Nothing is recorded.
Dreamsign reads your sleep from Health to show how sleep length and REM relate to the dreams you remember.
Dreamsign listens while you speak a dream into your journal. Audio isn't saved.
Dreamsign turns your spoken dreams into text, on your iPhone only.
